description: Install dependencies and verify the existing project builds and tests pass as a baseline before making changes.
steps: 1. Run `npm install` in /projects/sandbox/Only-5 to install all dependencies
2. Run `npm run build` to verify TypeScript compilation succeeds
3. Run `npm test` to verify all 353 existing tests pass
4. Report any issues found as blocked_reason
